title: Density attracts
brief: reading lands where reading already is
about: Where reading already is, the next reading lands: origins placed in proportion to the origins a cell already carries.
Over eight epochs the ratio between the densest tenth and the sparsest tenth rises at every epoch and the deserts stay empty.
The same budget of origins placed without regard to density holds that ratio near two and touches three times as many cells.

cases.name: two hundred origins over four hundred cells, eight epochs
